content.text:
Yes. At Claude Dojo, a nonprofit where he's Director of AI Enablement, Andrew taught at a two-day hands-on intensive with other instructors. About 70 people were in the room. Everyone set up Claude Code there and built their first Skill.

Altogether, he and the other instructors have taught 103 people to build with Claude Code. He also co-wrote Claude Dojo's 49-lesson curriculum.

Source: [Teaching 103 people to build with Claude Code](https://andrewyu.app/work/claude-dojo)
